column3: Check that all eyes are closed. Some Fabled act.
Show the Minion character token. Point to both the MINION & WRONG players.
The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
Wait for a few seconds. Call for eyes open.
If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the YOU ARE token, then the Demon Character token.

The Imp chooses a player. ⚫ If the Imp chose themselves: 
	Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the YOU ARE token, then show the Imp token.
If the Demon killed the Sage, wake the Sage & point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.
The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
Wait for a few seconds. End the Night Phase.
